title: Ancient Magic, Magnetism and Psychic Forces
author: L. H. Anderson
description: L. H. Anderson explores magic, personal magnetism and psychic forces within the historical literature of occult self-development. Read as an account of the beliefs and practices associated with mental influence and hidden capacities.
